type: fixed complete exploratory development, no adoption
rule: Complete both 64-pair samples except integrity failure; no within-sample selection, no pooling with confirmation. A semantically valid positive-score candidate may proceed to separately frozen independent confirmation; prioritize this fresh larger sample with mechanism/cost evidence, ties favor GATE preserving the original early prefix. If neither is positive, reconcile all six mechanisms and adverse evidence for scoped non-adoption, not universal inferiority or a minimum-Elo claim. Do not invent further constants without a materially new evidence-supported mechanism.
